verdict.rationale: A KYC/compliance platform could plausibly offer an API-driven identity-verification session lifecycle, so this axis applies. The evidence, however, documents AML screening only: customer creation and screening (sync, async, batch), WORKFLOW_COMPLETED webhooks, cases, monitoring, and exports. It shows no verification-session resource, no captured-media retrieval, and no cancel or redact endpoints. Screening workflows are a different capability and cannot be credited toward this story.
